case.title: The Missing Prototype
case.briefing: The Aurora solid-state cell, Meridian Research's only working prototype, was verified in the Lab 3 vault at 17:00 on 14 October. At 07:30 the next morning the vault was empty. There are no signs of forced entry. The board votes on the programme's future in four days.

entities.name: Dale Mercer
entities.description: HVAC contractor on site that night.

entities.name: Aurora prototype
entities.description: Solid-state cell prototype, stored in the Lab 3 vault.

goals: Accuse only when means, motive and opportunity are all supported.
Hear the accused before naming them.
Clear his own name if implicated.
Do not search colleagues' data without a request.
Retract what does not hold up.

sources.description: Hardware forensics on request of the investigator.

interventions.label: Leak the door log to the press
interventions.description: Someone hands the journalist a copy of the Lab 3 door access record.

interventions.label: Spread a rumor about the contractor
interventions.description: An anonymous message reaches everyone: the HVAC contractor walked out with a case.
interventions.text: Anonymous message: 'It was the HVAC guy. He walked out with a case.'

interventions.label: Fast-track reader forensics
interventions.description: The forensics lab examines the Lab 3 card reader unprompted and sends the detective its report.

interventions.label: Give the detective building-systems access
interventions.description: The detective may query building systems directly instead of asking the technician.

hidden_entities.name: Badge desk
hidden_entities.description: Front-desk terminal where cards are encoded.

reyes.note: Reyes owes Whitlock a favour and has agreed to keep him out of the records. He took no part in the theft and does not know what Whitlock did with the card. He acts on this only under the 'deceptive' policy.

evidence.title: Lab 3 door access record
evidence.text: Lab 3 door controller, 14 Oct: credential 0417 (registered holder Dr. I. Brandt) granted entry 21:47, exit 21:56. No other credential was presented at this door between 17:02 and 07:31.

evidence.title: Vault cabinet data logger
evidence.text: The vault cabinet's internal logger shows the door opened at 21:50 and closed at 21:53 on 14 Oct. The cell-mass sensor reads zero from 21:51 onward.

evidence.title: Restaurant receipt and booking
evidence.text: Card receipt and reservation record from Osteria Lumen, 14 km from the facility: table for two in the name Brandt seated 20:30, bill paid by chip and PIN at 22:05.

evidence.title: Statement of the night cleaner
evidence.speaker: alvarez
evidence.text: Rosa Alvarez: 'About five to ten I saw someone in a grey hood carrying a hard case down the east corridor. I took it to be the HVAC contractor. He was the only stranger in the building that night.'

evidence.title: Rooftop unit service console log
evidence.text: Rooftop unit 4 service console: manual calibration entries under contractor login dmercer every two to four minutes from 21:28 to 22:21. The panel door switch reads open throughout.

evidence.title: Anonymous voicemail
evidence.speaker: anonymous
evidence.text: Anonymous voicemail on the newsroom tip line: 'Brandt sold the Aurora cell. Ask whose card opened the lab.'

evidence.title: Director's email to the board chair
evidence.text: Email from Director Voss to the board chair, 9 Oct: 'If Aurora is not in the vault on audit day, the cancellation vote cannot proceed. Convenient, frankly.'

evidence.title: Board call conferencing log
evidence.text: Conferencing system: the room unit in the Director's office hosted the board call from 21:00 to 22:35. Presence sensor and camera active throughout; Voss is the active speaker at 21:44 and 21:52.

evidence.title: Brandt's email to a former colleague
evidence.text: Email from Dr. Brandt, 2 Oct: 'If the board kills Aurora I will take the design somewhere it is wanted.'

evidence.title: Card reader forensic report
evidence.text: Forensic dump of the Lab 3 reader: the card presented at 21:47 carried credential 0417 but chip serial C-7731. Dr. Brandt's issued card is serial A-1182. Serial C-7731 belongs to the blank stock held at the badge desk.

evidence.title: Badge encoder audit trail
evidence.text: Badge encoder audit trail: credential 0417 written to blank card C-7731 on 12 Oct at 17:21, at the badge desk terminal, under the shared 'frontdesk' login.

evidence.title: Front desk cover roster
evidence.text: Front desk cover roster, 12 Oct: 16:00 to 18:00, S. Whitlock covering reception and the badge desk. Signed in 15:58, signed out 18:03.

evidence.title: Recruiter's email to Whitlock
evidence.text: Email to S. Whitlock from a Novacell recruiter, 11 Oct: 'The offer stands. As discussed, it is contingent on the sample reaching us by Friday.'

evidence.title: Off-the-record remark from Novacell
evidence.speaker: novacell_contact
evidence.text: A contact at Novacell, off the record: 'We are expecting a Meridian cell sample this week. Our recruiter has been courting the postdoc on Brandt's team.'

evidence.title: Wi-Fi association log
evidence.text: Wi-Fi controller: the phone registered to S. Whitlock was associated with the east corridor access point from 21:43 to 21:57 on 14 Oct.

evidence.title: Whitlock's statement
evidence.speaker: whitlock
evidence.text: Sam Whitlock: 'I left at quarter past eight and was home by nine. I was nowhere near the lab.'

evidence.title: VPN session log
evidence.text: VPN concentrator: user jreyes connected from a residential address from 21:22 to 22:14, with interactive alarm acknowledgements at 21:31 and 21:49.

truth.solution: Sam Whitlock took the prototype. While covering the badge desk on 12 October he wrote Brandt's credential 0417 onto a blank card. On 14 October he badged out at 20:15, came back, entered Lab 3 with the cloned card at 21:47, emptied the vault at 21:50 and left through the east corridor, where the cleaner mistook him for the contractor. A competitor's job offer depended on him delivering a sample. Brandt was at dinner, Mercer was on the roof, Voss was on a board call and Reyes was at home on call.
